map.为什么阳性了患病概率还这么低？: Why Is the Probability of Disease So Low Even with a Positive Result?
map.先验很弱时单次证据即可大幅修正信念；证据越多后验越稳。: When the prior is weak, a single piece of evidence can revise the belief substantially; the more evidence there is, the more stable the posterior.
map.先验怎么取？: How Do You Set the Prior?
map.医学筛查中 A=患病、B=阳性，后验=P(患病|阳性) 即阳性预测值。: In medical screening A = diseased and B = test positive, so the posterior = P(diseased | positive), which is the positive predictive value.
map.可用人群发病率、历史数据或领域经验；证据充分时后验对先验不敏感，先验主要用于证据: Use the population incidence, historical data or domain experience; when the evidence is sufficient the posterior is insensitive to the prior, and the prior mainly serves as a regulariser when the evidence is weak.
map.因为基础患病率极低(1%)，大量健康人被检出的假阳性(5%)远多于真病人。贝叶斯: Because the base prevalence is extremely low (1%), false positives among the large number of healthy people tested (5%) far outnumber true patients. Bayes' theorem reminds us that the positive predictive value for rare events is naturally low and must be combined with a repeat test.
map.贝叶斯公式 P(A|B)=P(B|A)P(A)/P(B)，由先验 P(A) 与似: Bayes' formula P(A|B)=P(B|A)P(A)/P(B) updates the prior P(A) and the likelihood P(B|A) into the posterior.
map.贝叶斯定理在检测场景的直接应用：即便试剂敏感度、特异度都很高，若疾病先验极低，阳: A direct application of Bayes' theorem to testing: even when the reagent sensitivity and specificity are both high, if the prior probability of the disease is extremely low the positive predictive value can still be small (false positives dominate) — this is the mathematical basis for "a positive screening result ≠ having the disease", and also the reason why screening only makes sense in high-risk populations.
map.输入先验概率与似然，按贝叶斯公式更新后验概率，适用于医学筛查、垃圾识别与不确定性: Enter the prior probability and the likelihood, then update the posterior with Bayes' formula, for belief revision in medical screening, spam detection and uncertainty reasoning.
